# Recipes whose JSON deliberately differs from the Scala capture.
#
# The port's contract is that a hosted upstream recipe encodes exactly as the
# Scala did. Two things legitimately break that byte-identity, and both are
# recorded here so the difference is auditable rather than invisible:
#
#   * the prose (method steps, notes) is Markdown, not HTML or plain text, so a
#     recipe carrying inline HTML has its markup rewritten;
#   * a recipe has been corrected locally after the capture was taken.
#
# Every field of every recipe that is *not* listed here still has to match the
# capture byte for byte, and the test fails if an entry stops being needed, so
# the list cannot quietly rot.
#
# Format: <ObjectName> <field>[,<field>...]  # why
# Fields are the top-level JSON keys of the recipe response.

BeetrootRisotto notes  # markdown link; plus a local chaos note the capture predates
MeltyMushroomWellingtons ingredients_blocks,method  # spinach amount and bake time corrected locally
RoastBeetrootDahl notes  # markdown link
